headline: Ubisoft has reportedly named a new company-wide generative-AI unit 'Motherbrain', according to Insider Gaming.
score_reason: Light name hook on a reported plan Ubisoft has not confirmed.
importance_line: It could affect Ubisoft staff and players if confirmed, but the structure rests on unnamed sources and Ubisoft has not announced it.
summary: Insider Gaming reports, as relayed in an opinion column on Australian site Poptopic, that Ubisoft has named a new generative-AI operation 'Motherbrain' that would build shared AI tools, called middleware, for its studios, and that it sits beside a cost-cutting round seeking another 180 million euros in savings. Ubisoft has not publicly confirmed this structure, though its earnings release does say it is stepping up investment in AI game features.
notes: Original Insider Gaming article not read; url is the Poptopic column.
